descriptionHtml:
IEEE Student Activities Committee (SAC) and IEEE Student Branch of the University of Peradeniya proudly presented "IEEE අඬහැරය" enchanted with "Gajagā" Vannam arrived at the Hanthana premises, bringing another marvelous experience, Saturday, August 7, 2021, from 6 p.m. onwards, via Zoom.

Eng. Yasitha Harshanath, the event's guest speaker, is currently working as a Supervisory Engineer, Mobitel Pvt Ltd, and the Secretary of IEEE Communications Society Sri Lanka Chapter. He was also the winner of the IEEE Region 10's Larry K. Wilson award for outstanding student volunteer in 2018, the IEEE Sri Lanka Section Student Representative in 2017, and the Chairman of the IEEE Student Branch UOP in 2017.

The session was flawlessly arranged, and it was truly inspiring. The speaker shares his IEEE experience, and the audience had an opportunity to gain knowledge about IEEE. They all made the most of this opportunity with IEEE and gained a lot of things for their lives.
